300.title: Vietnam, Poland step up economic, investment, and tech ties under Strategic Partnership
300.summary: October 27, 2026 | 06:00 Vietnam, Poland step up economic, investment, and tech ties under Strategic Partnership Ly Ha Prime Minister Le Minh Hung and his Polish counterpart Donald Tusk on October 26 agreed to upgrade bilateral relations between Vietnam and Poland to a Strategic Partnership, adopted the joint Action Plan for the 2026-30 period and set a target to raise bilateral trade turnover to $6 billion by 2030.
300.body: October 27, 2026 | 06:00 Vietnam, Poland step up economic, investment, and tech ties under Strategic Partnership Ly Ha Prime Minister Le Minh Hung and his Polish counterpart Donald Tusk on October 26 agreed to upgrade bilateral relations between Vietnam and Poland to a Strategic Partnership, adopted the joint Action Plan for the 2026-30 period and set a target to raise bilateral trade turnover to $6 billion by 2030. Vietnam and Poland have identified the economy, trade, and investment as key pillars of their newly established Strategic Partnership, while agreeing to bolster cooperation in science and technology, innovation, digital transformation, and the rollout of a Joint Action Plan for the 2026–2030 period. Vietnam and Poland also consented to promote cooperation within the Poland – ASEAN framework following Poland’s accession to the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC), as well as under ASEAN – EU cooperation frameworks.
